**Ready for the maintainer to merge.** I tried to break the loosening and could not.

### What I checked by reasoning (from the code, not the PR body)
- The sweep lerps the letters linearly in degrees (`sweep.rs` `pose_letters`, `midpose::pose`) and the axis is `angles_to_axis` (`crates/cl/src/cl/pose.rs:68`), whose z component is `cos A * cos B` (C only turns about Z). So `cos θ(t) = cos A(t) * cos B(t)` with A(t), B(t) linear. That is the interpolation the law assumes.
- With both ends' A and B in the closed [-90, 90], the whole lerp stays there for both letters (convex range), so `cos A(t), cos B(t) >= 0` and `ln cos A + ln cos B` is a sum of concave functions: log-concave, so `cos θ` is smallest at an end (an end at exactly 90 gives 0, the true minimum, by continuity). With `above >= 0`, `len >= 0` and cos >= 0 the band bottom `above*cos θ - R*sin θ` is increasing in `cos θ`, so the more tilted end's own reading bounds every in-between pose. Holds with both A and B moving, spans crossing zero, one letter at the limit while the other is mid-range, and any C rotation. The closed cap is the limit of strict-cap spans (89.999...) that were already `None`, so nothing new is admitted beyond that limit.
- Float noise: 90.0000001 and anything past it, NaN, inf all fail `abs() <= 90` / `is_finite` and still take the interval floor (conservative; at worst a false refusal, never a miss). Lerped end values that land a hair past 90 also fall to the floor.
- The end at the limit is still judged where its band is deepest: the sampled pose itself keeps its exact reading (`None` only drops the *span* floor), and the new test pins a post under a horizontal end's band as refused.

### What looks good
- One-token change plus a module-doc law that matches the math; decision file present (`docs/decisions/1404-closed-tilt-cap.md`).
- No #1303/#1313/#1316 test touched; the only edits to existing tests are additions (400 more brute-force spans with ends at exactly +-90 in `tilt_span.rs`, new pin in `sweep_tests.rs`). The new pin asserts floor `+inf` at all five poses, a post at +10 clean, +40 refused, and a post under the horizontal end (top -2) refused, in both turn directions; by its comment and the assertion on the floor it fails on the strict cap.

### Local results (PR merged with current main; the merge touched only `crates/app/tests/pocket3d_hsm.rs`)
| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim --lib verify` | 84 passed |
| `cargo test -p camcraft-sim` (lib 143 passed, integration suites seen through `field_carry` all ok; the output I captured was truncated after that, later suites not read) | ok as far as read |
| `cargo clippy -p camcraft-sim --all-targets -- -D warnings` | clean |
| `cargo test --release -p camcraft-app --test operations -- --ignored swarf` | 2 passed (`swarf_generates_blade_lying_axes_and_verifies_clean_full_band`, `advanced_swarf_adds_the_coarse_rungs_full_band`) |

### Not verified
- I did not re-run the new tests against the strict cap to watch them fail; I read them and rely on the PR's statement and the 18 hits it reports.
- The rest of the sim integration suites past `field_carry`, and the rest of the release tier, were not run.

### Requested before merge
None.

### Notes (not blocking)
- Process: body ends `Fixes #1404`, has `Changelog:`; no CHANGELOG, snapshot, dependency, build.rs or process-file changes.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
